errors.text_span: Оста X е означена с числови стойности, които представляват години, започващи от 0 и приключващи с 5. Скалата е линейна и има равномерни интервали от 1 година.
errors.evidence: The X-axis in the figure has no labels, tick marks, or units. The entire description of the X-axis is fabricated.
The description fails to mention that there are two distinct lines: one solid and one dotted. The prompt specifically asks to describe line styles.

errors.text_span: Има лек спад в полезната стойност от 35,5% до 30,5%.
errors.evidence: Describing the line's movement as a simple "slight drop" is an oversimplification. The line drops, then stabilizes, then dips to a minimum, and finally rises. This description ignores the visible fluctuations.

The Y-axis does not have a unit label. The unit "проценти" (percentages) is inferred from the paper's caption, not from the visual information on the chart itself, which violates the prompt's instruction to describe only what is visually present.
The initial value of the line is visibly higher than 35.5, closer to 36.5.
The final value of the line is visibly higher than 30.5, closer to 31.5.
The phrase "полезната стойност" (useful value) is subjective and interpretive, which the prompt instructs to avoid.
The intervals on the Y-axis are at increments of the number 5, not '5%'. The unit applies to the axis values, not the interval itself.
